topic: Are there scalability limitations when applying the iterative power algorithm to dense multi-beam satellite networks?
response: Yes, there are scalability limitations when applying the iterative power algorithm to dense multi-beam satellite networks due to increased computational complexity and potential for channel estimation errors.
